personas.role: Quality engineer at a contract machining job shop that runs CMMs from several makers
goals: Turn existing CMM output into a customer-ready inspection report without retyping results
Use one report layout whichever machine or software produced the data
Hand the customer a report whose every value traces back to the source file

personas.role: Scan inspector comparing optical or laser scan data of parts against their CAD models
goals: Align a scanned part to its CAD model and see where and by how much it deviates
Evaluate the drawing's tolerances on scan data with a clear basis for each result
Run the same inspection on the next part of the batch with no manual set-up

personas.role: Shop-floor operator who enters hand-gauge readings and starts released inspection runs
goals: Start a released inspection from a kiosk screen without editing the program
Enter hand-gauge readings quickly and be warned at once when a value is out of tolerance
Know clearly whether the part passed and what to do next

personas.role: CMM programmer who writes, simulates and runs measurement programs
goals: Re-evaluate existing measurement data against the drawing without re-measuring the part
Build and simulate a probing program before running it on the machine
Run programs on an I++ DME capable machine and keep the results with their program version

personas.role: Quality manager who releases reports, watches process trends and owns the sign-off rules
goals: Approve and release reports with an electronic signature that names its meaning
Follow process capability and control charts across parts and lots
Set which approvals a release needs and see who signed what and when

personas.role: Auditor or calibration-lab reviewer who verifies a received results package
goals: Check that a results package is complete and has not been altered since release
Confirm signatures and replay evidence without a licence, an account or a network connection
Write down what was verified and what could not be checked

personas.role: Supplier quality engineer at a manufacturer who takes in inspection packages from suppliers
goals: Take in supplier inspection packages in one predictable format
Check incoming results against the released drawing requirements
Accept or reject a delivery with a recorded and signed reason

personas.role: Engineer at a measuring-instrument maker who writes the driver for their device
goals: Connect a measuring device through a documented driver interface
Test the driver against a simulator and the project's conformance checks
Ship the driver without changing the core software

personas.role: Large-volume metrologist who runs laser-tracker networks for build and fixture work
goals: Combine several instrument stations into one network with stated uncertainty
Guide the build and setting of jigs and fixtures from live readings
Report network results with the instrument data behind them
